artifacts.name: Houmuwu Ding
artifacts.description: It is a huge bronze sacrificial vessel from the Shang Dynasty unearthed in Anyang.

artifacts.name: Zeng Houyi Bianzhong
artifacts.description: This is a complete set of chime bells buried with Marquis Zeng of the Warring States Period.

artifacts.name: Gilded Silver Pot with Dancing Horse

artifacts.name: Gold-inlaid Bronze Rhinoceros Zun
artifacts.description: It is a Western Han wine container shaped like a real rhinoceros covered with gold cloud patterns.
